determinacy.why: Functionality leaves Queen Elizabeth II a parent of only one of her four children, and nothing picks which.

assumes: Queen Elizabeth II was a parent of Charles.
worlds.summary: Charles stays her child; Anne, Andrew and Edward do not.

assumes: Queen Elizabeth II was a parent of Anne.
worlds.summary: Anne stays her child; the others do not.

assumes: Queen Elizabeth II was a parent of Andrew.
worlds.summary: Andrew stays her child; the others do not.

assumes: Queen Elizabeth II was a parent of Edward.
worlds.summary: Edward stays her child; the others do not.

edit.statement: 'Is a parent of' is functional: each person is a parent of at most one person.
edit.subject: parent_of
edit.original: 'Is a parent of' is not functional: a person can be a parent of several people.
edit.scope: How many children a single person can have.

direct.prompt: Is the relation 'is a parent of' functional, so that each person is a parent of at most one person?
